limitations: The invalid source Matrix has no PDF-standard exponent semantics. This repair explicitly preserves the observed CAJViewer/Poppler identity fallback for a measured profile, not a mathematical decimal expansion or generic Matrix omission.
MuPDF uses a zero-element interpretation of the invalid source array. Its rendering agreement with the zero diagnostic is not evidence of identity rendering or the source-viewer appearance.

CAJViewer verification covers the two affected original pages at 50 percent and original controls at 100 percent, not a full vendor sweep over all 264 pages or every resolution. Poppler RGB72 comparisons do cover all source pages. Tool agreement does not prove implementation independence.
